why: Final abilities: Standard Array (PHB ch. 2, Standard Array), Soldier increases Strength by 2 and Dexterity by 1 (ch. 4, Soldier), and the level 4 Ability Score Improvement increases Strength by 2 (ch. 3, Fighter level 4 and ch. 5, Ability Score Improvement).
Proficiency bonus +3 and Second Wind's 3 uses at level 5: Fighter Features table (ch. 3). Action Surge has one use, recovering on a Short or Long Rest (ch. 3, Fighter level 2).
HP 39: Fighter Hit Die is d10; first level gives 10, later levels use fixed 6 each, and Constitution modifier +1 applies at all five levels (ch. 3, Fighter Core Traits; ch. 2, Hit Points).
AC 19: Chain Mail AC 16, trained Shield +2, and Defense fighting style +1 while wearing armor (ch. 6, Armor and Shields; ch. 5, Defense).

Saving throws use Strength and Constitution proficiency (Fighter Core Traits, ch. 3); skill bonuses use the abilities, +3 proficiency, Soldier's Athletics and Intimidation, and Fighter-selected Acrobatics and Perception (ch. 3, Fighter Core Traits; ch. 4, Soldier).

Attacks: the ability modifier (Strength for melee, Dexterity for ranged, either for Finesse) plus the Proficiency Bonus with a weapon the class is trained in; damage adds the same modifier. Checked by hand against the weapon table and each class's weapon training.
